methods.name: Natural effect models (medflex imputation estimator): difference, ratio and odds-ratio scales
methods.reference: Vansteelandt, Bekaert & Lange (2012) imputation estimator as medflex 0.6-11 neImpute + neModel(se = 'robust' | 'bootstrap') + neEffdecomp(covLev = colMeans(C)), written out and cross-checked in the case against medflex 0.6-11 (neImpute + neModel: natural effect model coefficients to 1e-8, robust variance to 1e-6 relative); stats::glm; boot::norm.ci; cross-checks sandwich::vcovHC(HC0), VanderWeele (2015), numDeriv
quantities: outcome working-model coefficients and SEs (gaussian, poisson, binomial)
NDE, NIE, TE on the difference, ratio and odds-ratio scales
robust (stacked sandwich) SEs, 95% CIs and p-values
bootstrap draws, SEs and normal-type CIs on fixed resamples
mediator model coefficient, SE and R2
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 500: gaussian fits coefficients 1e-8 and SEs 1e-6 relative (Tol::coef, Tol::se); poisson and binomial working models and the quasi natural effect models Tol::iterative(1e-8) (fit_glm epsilon 1e-10 against R at 1e-14; measured difference <= 6.4e-13), except the binomial and poisson working-model SEs, Tol::iterative(1e-6): summary.glm SEs from the last IRLS step's working weights converge linearly (1.8e-7 measured)

deviations.quantity: natural effect model formula and contrast level
deviations.note: with A:M the model carries A0:C and the effects are evaluated at the confounder means; medflex's usual formula Y ~ A0 * A1 + C gives the raw-mean NDE CAUS-23 reports as biased, and neEffdecomp's default covLev is 0
refused; medflex samples hypothetical levels for a continuous exposure

methods.name: Causal mediation (Huber IPW): glm propensity total effect, type-7 percentile rule
methods.reference: stats::glm(binomial) propensity scores and the Hajek total effect with p2a's trimming rule, written out (causalweight not installed); stats::quantile(type = 7), sd
methods.tolerance: total effect Tol::iterative(1e-8) (glm.fit epsilon 1e-10 against R 1e-14); percentile and SD Tol::coef(199) (exact arithmetic)

deviations.note: the NDE weight is Tier 4; not pinned
